articles.title: Kansas City Life Insurance (KCLI) Stock Faces Q3 Earnings Profit Squeeze
articles.summary: Kansas City Life Insurance slipped 0.3% to close at US$34.65 as the market shrugged at its Q3 2026 report. The reaction was calm. The earnings line was not. Basic earnings per share dropped to US$0.18 on net income of US$1.7 million, a sharp squeeze compared with the prior two quarters. That kind of compression matters far more to a life insurer than a one day move in the quote. Short term traders saw a flat chart.
